testCase.name: [本地] S13a Next server day: overlap scan after the day roll, each existing field checked against its retention window

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S13a 「下一个服务器日：换日后的重叠扫描，每个已有字段都按它的保留窗口查」 Next server day: overlap scan after the day roll, each existing field checked against its retention window

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. …（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 5；TFA-92580 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U5 An overlapping scan leaves existing patients' data untouched.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 4；TFA-92580 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U11 'Day 2' and the Follow-up rule follow the server clock, not the device clock. A device set to the wrong date shows the same state (3.8).（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Local stack only (convex dev --local on 4510/4511, web on 6473), never dev or prod. Day-1 state from the previous server day, made with the aging helper. Hospital: QA Alder (on the day-2 photo) and the control QA Fig, room 404, who is on no photo. …

When On the next server day, scan h-day2-overlap.jpg and n-day2-overlap.jpg and settle the overlap

Then The overlap prompt appears. Each overlapped patient's chart equals its control's retention-adjusted state. The open task, the medication row and the vitals are still there (36 h windows), and in Nursing Home the chronic medications and open tasks persist. New Admission has turned to Follow-up on both, by the documented day rule (TC-04). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Compare each overlapped patient with its control, field by field. Any difference the scan caused is a Fail. Anything a 3.6/3.7 window clears (Hospital pre-round text at 12 h) is not judged here, because it is retention, not the scan. The day roll by device clock is known: TFA-92584

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status passed-partial → 通过（部分通过（判过的格子都通过，有一部分没跑 / 是模拟的））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Playwright chromium spec. Seed QA Alder + control QA Fig (Hospital) and QA Juniper + control QA Yarrow (NH) with the day-1 state, every stamp ~20 h back (previous server day) and New Admission set yesterday (encTypeDay = yesterday). Open the list (page-load lifecycle runs = next day), scan with the census-scan action answered at the Convex socket by the h-day2-overlap / n-day2-overlap rows (trackActionRequests, as Tim's patient-list-capture spec does), settle the overlap (Same patient). Then compare overlapped vs control field by field on the server (tasks, medications, vitals, encType, room, diagnosis) and check new rows are Follow-up. The Hospital overlap cell requires the prompt to name QA Alder as already on the list; the NH cell requires QA Juniper's own row to carry '✓ In panel'. The UAT wording ('N patients are already on your list' + 'add only the new ones') is not judged (U4 gated, TFA-92580). — The overlap merge and the retention-adjusted state are deterministic and checkable. The photo read itself is mocked at the socket (reading accuracy is S11/S12's job); a real phone photo stays with S11/S12 on dev.

Detail:

12/12 judged cells pass, 2 recorded. Partial: the census photo read is answered at the Convex socket with the h-/n-day2-overlap rows (reading accuracy is S11/S12's job, on dev). Recorded: QA Alder's room / diagnosis after the day-2 photo (Q7) = {"room":"401","diagnosis":"Heart failure"} | QA Juniper's unit after the photo (Cedar 19) and the control leaving Today's Visits (Q6/Q7) = {"juniperUnit":"Cedar 10","yarrowInToday":false}.

跑的时候（runNote）：1 of 3 Hospital runs (14:5x): right after 'Add 5 Patients…' the page showed 'Loading…' and nothing was added (no prompt, no console error), while the local backend was overloaded ('Function execution timed out (maximum duration: 1s)', disk full); the reruns were clean. Not counted.
